summary: BBN's traffic statistics for the ARPANET hosts for May 1973, as tables of packets output per host. It updates RFC 509.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC shares the Host Throughput Summary for May 1973. It counts packets sent between nodes and within nodes, with totals for the reporting period.

subtitle: BBN's host-by-host packet counts for ARPANET traffic in May 1973.

tldr.problem: The Network community wanted regular figures on how much traffic each Host put onto the ARPANET.
tldr.mechanism: The Host Throughput Summary lists packets output by host, separates internode and intranode traffic, and provides totals and averages.
tldr.outcome: RFC 522 reports May 1973 measurements and updates RFC 509. It is a statistics memo rather than a protocol.

sections.title: The May Traffic Report
sections.content: A. McKenzie of BBN-NET attaches the host traffic statistics for May 1973. The RFC updates RFC 509 and includes a table titled Host Throughput Summary (Packets Output).
sections.plainLanguage: This is a monthly statistics report, not a network protocol. It records packets output by each listed host.

sections.title: The Host Throughput Table
sections.content:
For each host, the table lists internode packets sent to other nodes and intranode packets within a node, along with totals. Site subtotals include an average daily internode figure and the days represented.

Most entries cover the full month. The table marks some hosts as having no traffic.
sections.plainLanguage: Each row separates traffic that left a node from traffic that stayed within it. Site totals combine host rows and show the reporting period.

sections.title: Totals and Daily Averages
sections.content:
The report provides overall totals for internode and intranode packets, daily averages, averages per node-day, and a packets-to-messages ratio for internode traffic.

These values summarize measured output during the period and do not prescribe host behavior.
sections.plainLanguage: The last rows add up the measurements and provide averages. They describe traffic during the month covered by the table.
